holds.reason: The town approved a development agreement on November 12. The state registration gives a street address absent from the federal address points. The mapped zoning district and parent tax tract differ in area from the 87.96-acre development, so neither centroid was used.

Antel announced its new facility on November 10. It gives a 2.5-hectare site within 6.5 hectares of ANEP land near two roads. The event took place off-site; no matching parcel identifier was established.

State registration at 1520 W Mockingbird Lane has no matching parcel situs, federal address point or municipal construction permit. The Census street interpolation falls beyond the parcel results. Neighboring DA12 is already present at 1550.
The current expansion evidence does not yet resolve the separately named TR6 scope against construction notices for both TR6 and TR7. A numbered address alone cannot assign both scopes.
Public environmental filings identify the development. A reusable site-level property locator matched to the data-centre parcel remains under review.
